components.name: Primary button
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">Explorar la tienda <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h15M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 34px; min-height: 50px; padding: 14px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #783d49; color: #fff; font: 600 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #60303b; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Outlined add button
components.description: Explicit product action, visible independently of the photo overlay.
components.html: <button class="ds-add">Agregar <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-add { display: inline-flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #783d49; border: 1px solid #b88791; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add:hover { background: #783d49; color: #fff; } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Checkout button
components.description: Payment-specific action retaining the existing Mercado Pago color role.
components.html: <button class="ds-payment">Pagar con Mercado Pago <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h15M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-payment { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; width: 100%; border: 0; background: #007caf; color: #fff; padding: 15px 14px; font: 700 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 7px; min-height: 50px; } .ds-payment:hover { background: #00618b; } .ds-payment:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: Labeled garment search with a leading icon and readable placeholder.
components.css: .ds-search { display: block; font: 500 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; color: #29241f; } .ds-search > div { margin-top: 9px; position: relative; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 14px; color: #70645b; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 50px; padding: 12px 40px 12px 45px; border: 1px solid #c9bcb1; border-radius: 7px; background: #fffdfa; color: #29241f; font: 400 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; caret-color: #783d49; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #78675e; opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Store navigation
components.description: Dark header navigation with a clear current-page underline.
components.html: InicioTodas las prendasContacto
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center; padding: 20px; background: #29241f; } .ds-nav a { padding: 14px 0; color: #ede1d8; font: 400 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: #fff; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 9px; text-decoration-color: #c897a0; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #e4b0bd; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a { transition: none; } }

components.name: Category pill
components.description: Outlined category navigation derived from the garment-type links.
components.html: Todas las prendas
components.css: .ds-category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; border: 1px solid #ddd4ca; border-radius: 30px; padding: 13px 22px; background: #fffdfa; color: #29241f; font: 400 14px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-category svg { width: 18px; } .ds-category:hover { background: #eee0e0; border-color: #b88791; } .ds-category:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-category { transition: none; } }

components.name: Product image fallback
components.description: The existing neutral branded state for a garment with no catalog photograph.
components.css: .ds-product-fallback { display: block; position: relative; width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 4/5; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #eee8e1; color: #29241f; cursor: pointer; } .ds-no-photo { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; color: #70645b; font: 400 26px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-no-photo > span { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .4em; } .ds-photo-action { position: absolute; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; right: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fffdfa; color: #3e302a; font: 400 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-product-fallback:hover .ds-photo-action, .ds-product-fallback:focus-visible .ds-photo-action { opacity: 1; } .ds-product-fallback:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-photo-action { transition: none; } }

components.name: Selected size option
components.description: Selected garment size control in product options.
components.css: .ds-option { border: 1px solid #783d49; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #783d49; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a85f70; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Fenixis Store uses a warm, photo-led clothing storefront: pale ivory surfaces, brown-black typography and a restrained wine accent. Large plain-language headings pair a clean sans serif with italic serif emphasis, while real garment photographs carry the visual character.

The seller area uses the same palette in a denser working layout. This document records the implemented interface, rather than introducing a new brand promise or merchandising policy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory canvas with dark header and footer.
DM Sans hierarchy with selective Playfair Display italic emphasis.
Real garment photography in portrait frames.
Flat surfaces, fine borders and gently rounded controls.
Responsive browsing and readable mobile forms.
dos: **Do** reuse the supplied Fenixis wordmark and actual catalog photographs.
**Do** keep garment names, prices, sizes and colors readable outside the photograph.
**Do** use the wine accent for store actions and selected options; reserve payment blue for checkout.
**Do** keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
**Do** use a neutral branded placeholder when a catalog photograph is missing.
donts: **Don't** fabricate photographs, stock claims, discounts, testimonials or delivery promises.
**Don't** require hover to discover the product title, price or add action.
**Don't** replace the supplied wordmark with a text approximation.
**Don't** introduce customization controls into new clothing orders.
